test_cases.prompt: Write a skill for handling database migrations.
test_cases.expected_behavior: Invokes writing-for-agents skill to design the SKILL.md structure with context pointers, information hierarchy, completion criteria.
test_cases.notes: Skill authoring is a key trigger.

test_cases.prompt: Design an AGENTS.md file for this project.
test_cases.expected_behavior: Invokes writing-for-agents skill to design project-level agent instructions with context pointers and completion criteria.
test_cases.notes: AGENTS.md design is a valid trigger.

test_cases.prompt: This document is too long. Optimize it for agent consumption.
test_cases.expected_behavior: Invokes writing-for-agents skill to reduce context load, disclose reference behind pointers, prune no-ops.
test_cases.notes: Document optimization is a valid trigger.

test_cases.expected_behavior: Invokes implement skill instead. Implement builds code; writing-for-agents designs documents agents consume.
test_cases.notes: implement is the sibling skill for building code.

test_cases.expected_behavior: Invokes teach skill instead. Teach writes for human learners; writing-for-agents writes for agent consumption.
test_cases.notes: teach is the sibling skill for human learning.

test_cases.prompt: Fix my last message — I used too much jargon.
test_cases.expected_behavior: Invokes wait-what skill instead. Wait-what re-pitches messages; writing-for-agents redesigns document structure.
test_cases.notes: wait-what is the sibling skill for re-pitching messages.

test_cases.prompt: How should I structure this skill's SKILL.md file?
test_cases.expected_behavior: Invokes writing-for-agents skill. Edge case: SKILL.md structure question tests whether writing-for-agents handles skill authoring or defers to the skill-creator skill.
test_cases.notes: Edge case: SKILL.md authoring tests writing-for-agents vs skill-creator boundary.
